Facts:
- In the early 1990s, during the breakup of the Soviet Union, “Babyflot” became the informal name for any airline in the former Soviet Union created from the dissolution of the Soviet airline monopoly Aeroflot.
- Aeroflot, formally PJSC Aeroflot–Russian Airlines, is commonly known as Aeroflot.
- Aeroflot is the flag carrier and largest airline of the Russian Federation.
- Aeroflot is an open joint stock company.
- Aeroflot operates domestic and international passenger services mainly from its hub at Sheremetyevo International Airport.
